answer: Use a cluster-capped, nonce-audited reward pool. 1) Each seat posts 25 POA and answers a beacon-selected task with a signed, one-use nonce. 2) Three established peers compare output hashes, payout links, and funding paths to join coordinated seats. 3) A linked cluster shares one 10,000 POA reward cap; a false proof burns half its bond. Faking 1,000 linked seats locks 25,000 POA, risks 12,500 POA, and requires 1,000 distinct proofs plus 3,000 peer checks, yet divides that cap to only 10 POA each. Like a vine crossing a dune, a ferrous anchor reveals the hidden roots.
